company: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute
role_summary: Strategic leadership role responsible for defining the research roadmap for Agentic AI, Generative AI, and LLM platforms, while overseeing Digital Health, Intelligent Manufacturing, FinTech, and Trusted Technology solution domains.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years experience in technology research and R&D
8+ years in senior leadership managing large, multidisciplinary teams
Proven track record in LLM, LVLM, Agentic AI, and Generative AI development
Experience commercializing technology from lab to market (0-to-1 to 1-to-10)
Strong background in Trusted Tech (cybersecurity/privacy) or FinTech
Experience with cloud architectures, containerization, and modern MLOps pipelines
Proven ability to interface with government funding bodies and C-level stakeholders
nice_to_have_requirements: History within publicly funded or highly regulated research environments

scoring_criteria.name: AI/Agentic R&D Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must drive the foundational Agentic AI platform strategy.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates without hands-on LLM strategy experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Commercialization Success
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: ASTRI requires turning research into tangible industrial impact.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Purely academic researchers without industry product experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Management Scale
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must manage a large, multidisciplinary team.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Individual contributors or functional team leads of small units.

scoring_criteria.name: Trusted Tech/FinTech Domain
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Domain alignment with critical solution areas.

scoring_criteria.name: System Deployment Acumen
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensures research is architecturally sound for real-world piloting.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates strictly from theoretical research backgrounds.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Grant Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Funding is tied to ability to justify technology impact to officials.

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Ambiguity Handling
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: High-profile role requiring diplomatic navigation of complex stakeholder environments.

summary_focus: Focus on the intersection of deep AI research and industrial commercialization.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming 'lead' status if you managed individual tasks rather than large R&D teams.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize yourself as a 'Bridge-Builder' who connects academic R&D to economic industrial impact.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If domain experience in FinTech is light, emphasize transferable architectural frameworks used in high-security environments.
